title: Sales Page Question Framework
note:
1. music is no longer a personal thing. Remember they feeling of going to the record store or Best Buy to get your favorite artists album? That’s gone. It’s now just add, shuffle, move on.
2. You get to own and access my new album at your convenience without apps (distraction), without cords (Bluetooth), without complexity (maybe change this bullet). You get a candle I’ve personally crafted an all natural essential oil scent to burn while listening and it includes bonus songs that didn’t make the album. Your purchase gives you access to my exclusive listening party automatically.
3. My team and I have been planning this release for 1 year and we designed this album and device with intention. Making it easily portable, Bluetooth capable for convenience in listening preference and thoughtful with your experience in mind. If this is your first time discovering my music then here’s what others are saying: (show comments)
4. You be might thinking “why” did I choose to sell my album this way. Because if you’re anything like me you value music with meaning, art that makes you think, Gods timing, and becoming a better you.
5. Tech companies have morphed music into something cheap. They’ve made us believe that all music in the world at your finger tips is world $9.99. This has conditioned artists and listeners to think that music should be basically free but music touches every aspect of our lives and even our death someone usually sings at the funeral. Music is how we heal, evolve, and exist. Think about someone who doesn’t like music, you can’t. This is why I’m made my album available this way because I believe that owning it in its true form without algorithms, apps, likes, and saves gives you the chance to actually feel and absorb the messages and melodies.
6. Why now? Because change in the music industry is needed now and I don’t wait for someone else to make it happen when I’m more than capable of affecting change myself. I want to set an example for artists out there that their art is valuable. By purchasing this album that is the statement you’re making. Music is still valuable to us. Music still means something more than a like or save on an app. Technology and AI can never replace the emotions that connects us as humans. 
7. My hope is that my courage and intention I’ve set in this music and product encourages you to believe anything is possible. If you’ve already heard my other music before now you know I put my everything into it to give you an experience and this will be nothing less. 
8. Product details 
9. CTA around purchasing and next steps 
10. Can I evolve? Is really a no-risk album. The other thing you have to lose is the belief that music should be free and that artists should accept less than 1 cent everytime someone plays their music online.

title: Fan funnel
content:
If you want to go direct to consumer you need a funnel: 


1.  Discovery - the first point of content with your potential fan… ads they see, reels the watch, or even music they listen to. 


2.  Engagement - when someone clicks your profile to watch more videos and content. 


3.  Conversion - when someone hits the link on your bio and signs up to your email list… 


4.  Retention - now you can retarget them with email marketing and ads to keep driving fans towards your end product which is your albums, merch, or tickets… 


that’s what a funnel is ☝️
